<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read input file
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
missingness_report_file = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
selected_matrix_file = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the input data
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Compute missingness for each indicator
missingness_report = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0
    kept = 'True' if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 'False'
    missingness_report.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create missingness report dataframe
report_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_report)
report_df.to_csv(missingness_report_file, index=False)

# Create selected matrix with only indicators that are kept
kept_indicator_names = [col for col in indicator_cols if missingness_report[missingness_report.index(col)]['kept'] == 'True']
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicator_names]
selected_df.to_csv(selected_matrix_file, index=False)
</solution_file>
